batch_capability.help_response:
submitrawtxbatch ["rawtx",...] ( maxfeerate )

Submit a batch of raw transactions (serialized, hex-encoded) in dependency order with two-phase all-or-nothing semantics.
Phase 1 validates the entire batch under cs_main without mutating the mempool. If any transaction fails validation or exceeds maxfeerate, no transactions in the batch are accepted.
Phase 2 commits all validated transactions to the mempool under the same cs_main lock acquisition, refreshes the RCU snapshot, and broadcasts them.

The node announces transactions it originated to all of its peers at the next relay tick, without delay, so peers can tell which node they came from. For privacy, submit each transaction to several independent nodes rather than to one.

Arguments:
1. rawtxs          (json array, required) An array of hex strings of raw transactions.
     [
       "rawtx",    (string)
       ...
     ]
2. maxfeerate      (numeric or string, optional, default="100000.00") Reject transactions whose fee rate is higher than the specified value, expressed in XEC/kB
                   Set to 0 to accept any fee rate.
                   

Result:
{                                        (json object)
  "accepted" : true|false,               (boolean) True if all transactions in the batch were accepted into the mempool
  "package-error" : "str",               (string, optional) Package validation error, if any
  "txids" : [                            (json array) Transaction IDs in input order
    "hex",                               (string) The transaction id in hex
    ...
  ],
  "results" : [                          (json array) Per-transaction validation results in input order
    {                                    (json object)
      "txid" : "hex",                    (string) The transaction id in hex
      "allowed" : true|false,            (boolean, optional) Whether this transaction passed validation
      "size" : n,                        (numeric, optional) Virtual transaction size
      "fees" : {                         (json object, optional) Transaction fees
        "base" : n,                      (numeric) transaction fee in XEC
        "effective-feerate" : n,         (numeric) effective feerate in XEC per KvB
        "effective-includes" : [         (json array) txids included in effective-feerate
          "hex",                         (string) transaction txid in hex
          ...
        ]
      },
      "reject-reason" : "str",           (string, optional) Rejection reason string
      "reject-details" : "str",          (string, optional) Rejection details string
      "required_cu" : n,                 (numeric, optional) Required transaction compute units (CU)
      "required_fee_sats" : n,           (numeric, optional) Minimum required RPC admission fee in satoshis
      "recommended_sdk_fee_sats" : n     (numeric, optional) Recommended SDK fee in satoshis (includes +5% anti-bounce cushion)
    },
    ...
  ]
}

Examples:
> bitcoin-cli submitrawtxbatch '["signedhex"]'
> curl --user myusername --data-binary '{"jsonrpc": "1.0", "id": "curltest", "method": "submitrawtxbatch", "params": [["signedhex"]]}' -H 'content-type: text/plain;' http://127.0.0.1:8332/
